The data part of a report's program

Source: R/programs.R
data_lines.Rd

The code a report runs before the report is laid out: the setup every report runs, the report's own data_code (its ARD) and, for a table, its process_code (normalization and rework, by default data <- normalize_ard(ard)). With no data_code it is a TODO that stops. program_code() writes it into the program, and fetch_ard() runs it to learn what the ARD holds.

Usage

data_lines(x, output_id, todo = TRUE)

Arguments

x

An tflplanner.

output_id

The report.

todo

FALSE returns NULL instead of the TODO.

Value

Code lines.
